bullets.text: On 9 September 2025 Halvern Dam on the Sorrel River above Brindlemark in the Assek Valley was reported damaged, including its right abutment.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority and the dam operator issued information on the damage, and by the following morning the alert level had been raised from Yellow to Orange.
No casualties were reported in the window; a mandatory evacuation moved roughly 11,800 residents out of Brindlemark, with Ferris Hollow also evacuated.
Evacuations were ongoing at the end of the window, with the condition of the dam under assessment by the water authority and the operator.
Halvern Dam and its right abutment are reported damaged on the afternoon of the first day.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority and later the operator provide information on the dam's condition.
The following morning a mandatory evacuation is ordered for Brindlemark and Ferris Hollow; the alert level is raised from Yellow to Orange.
Roughly 11,800 residents are moved out of Brindlemark as the window closes.
Halvern Dam and its right abutment were damaged.
A mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brindlemark after the dam was damaged.
People were also evacuated from Ferris Hollow under the mandatory order.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark.
The alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange, alongside the mandatory evacuation of Brindlemark.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority issued information updates on the condition of Halvern Dam.
The dam operator provided information on the incident on the first evening.
